host.encoder_options: integer level; no multithread option; max_frame_content_size omitted for default

load_end.method: two /proc process snapshots; any foreign CPU tick or known compute process makes busy; OS daemon ticks recorded separately

load_start.method: two /proc process snapshots; any foreign CPU tick or known compute process makes busy; OS daemon ticks recorded separately

peak_rss_scope: timed-repeat child process, including resident archive and request buffers
timer: time.perf_counter_ns; open separate; seek+read first and repeat
